headline: Binance Receives In-Principle Approval for Bhutan Digital-Asset Hub
summary: Binance received in-principle approval from Bhutan’s Gelephu Central Bank to establish regulated digital-asset operations as part of its Asian expansion.
why: Regulatory approvals in new jurisdictions enable major cryptocurrency exchanges to expand their compliant operations and access new regional markets.

impacts.name: Binance
impacts.why: Binance received regulatory approval to establish operations in Bhutan.
